package.description: Local AI Document Reader & Floating Audio Pill with Kokoro Neural Voices

en-US.description: Local AI Document Reader & Floating Audio Pill with Kokoro Neural Voices
en-US.longDescription:
Voxify is a private, local document-to-audiobook desktop application and system-wide
floating audio pill powered by Kokoro-82M neural voice synthesis. It allows listening
to selected text across Windows with zero cloud latency and complete privacy.
en-US.name: Voxify
